nodes.description: Internal view function returning msg.sender as address payable; the single source of caller identity for the token contract.
Attacker controllable caller address read inside _call() and used for ownership checks, minting and transfers.
Internal transfer routine that mutates _router balances, reads caller/router/rTotal gating values and emits Transfer.
Public transferFrom that moves tokens and decrements the spender allowance via SafeMath.sub.
Public ERC20 transfer forwarding to _transfer with _call() as sender.
Public approve that delegates to private _approve for the caller as owner.
Owner-only mint-like function that inflates _totalTokens and the owner balance, emitting a Transfer from address(0).
Owner-only function that rewrites the sell/burn threshold rTotal from a raw, unguarded multiplication.
Owner-only setter writing an arbitrary address into the caller state variable used by _transfer gating.
Owner-only setter writing an arbitrary address into the router state variable used as the sell destination check.
Owner-only function clearing _owner and the public Owner mirror to address(0).
Owner-only transfer of _owner to a new address after a zero-address check.
Access control modifier requiring _owner == _call(); represented as a function node that gates privileged entry points.
Private owner address used by the onlyOwner modifier and updated by ownership functions.
Public mirror of the owner address kept in sync with _owner.
Mapping(address=>uint256) holding all token balances; initial supply assigned to deployer in constructor.
Address treated as the sell destination (router) inside _transfer gating.
Address excluded from the sell size restriction inside _transfer; writable by owner via Approve.
Total supply value, inflatable by the owner through increaseAllowance.
Maximum amount allowed per sell, writable by the owner through decreaseAllowance.
Nested mapping of owner-spender allowances written by _approve.
External low-level call forwarding ether to an arbitrary recipient without state protection.
External low-level call executing arbitrary calldata against an attacker supplied target contract.
Unguarded multiplication amount * 10**18 assigned to rTotal; no SafeMath, overflow silently wraps.
Constructor minting the whole supply to the deployer and setting the owner state variables.
Private allowance writer validating owner and spender are non-zero.
Source address parameter of _transfer.
Destination address parameter of _transfer.
Amount parameter of _transfer, used as the sell size and balance deltas.
Owner supplied amount parameter multiplied by 10**18 to set rTotal.
New owner address parameter for transferOwnership.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Amount parameter of transferFrom used for the balance move and allowance decrement.
Address parameter stored into the caller state variable by Approve.
Address parameter stored into the router state variable by setrouteChain.

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by _call(), propagating caller identity into all functions that use _call().
transfer resolves the sender through _call() before invoking _transfer.
transferFrom uses _call() as the spender when decrementing the allowance.
approve passes _call() as the allowance owner.
Constructor mints the initial supply to the address returned by _call().
onlyOwner compares the stored owner with _call(), so caller identity controls privileged execution.
Attacker controlled msg.sender flows into the onlyOwner equality check guarding privileged functions.
transfer delegates all balance mutation to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the balance move to _transfer before adjusting the allowance.
transferFrom calls _approve to write the reduced allowance.
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
increaseAllowance is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
decreaseAllowance is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
Approve is gated by the onlyOwner modifier and rewrites the sell exemption address.
setrouteChain is gated by the onlyOwner modifier and rewrites the sell destination address.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
Constructor writes the full supply into the _router balance mapping of the deployer.
Ownable constructor stores the deployer address in the private _owner variable.
Ownable constructor stores the deployer address in the public Owner mirror.
renounceOwnership resets the privileged _owner reference to address(0).
renounceOwnership clears the public Owner mirror.
transferOwnership rewrites _owner, changing who passes the onlyOwner gate.
The owner supplied amount parameter feeds the unchecked multiplication that sets rTotal.
decreaseAllowance executes the unguarded multiply without SafeMath before assigning rTotal.
Result of the unchecked multiplication is written into the rTotal sell threshold variable.
increaseAllowance adds to the total supply, permanently inflating _totalTokens.
increaseAllowance credits the caller balance in _router alongside the supply increase.
Approve overwrites the caller state variable that exempts an address from the sell limit.
setrouteChain overwrites the router state variable used as the sell destination check.
_transfer subtracts from the sender balance and adds to the recipient balance in _router.
_transfer reads rTotal inside the sell size requirement.
_transfer compares the recipient against the router state variable to detect a sell.
_transfer compares the sender against the caller state variable to bypass the sell limit.
_approve writes the nested allowance mapping.
Low-level call in _functionCallWithValue hands control to an arbitrary contract which may re-enter token transfer logic.
sender parameter is used for the zero-address check and balance decrement in _transfer.
recipient parameter is used for the zero-address check and balance increment in _transfer.
amount parameter drives the sell size requirement and both balance updates in _transfer.
newOwner parameter is validated and written into the owner state variable.
spender parameter is forwarded to _approve from approve.
amount parameter drives the balance move and allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
trade parameter is written into the caller state variable by the owner-only Approve.
Uniswaprouterv02 parameter is written into the router state variable by the owner-only setter.

Value-only parameter fully captured by the enclosing internal function node.
Value-only parameter that only affects balances inside _transfer.
Parameter is consumed solely by the unguarded multiplication that computes rTotal.
Parameter exists only to update the owner state variable inside the same function.
Parameter is passed straight through to _approve and carries no independent behavior.
Parameter is used only for the delegated transfer and allowance decrement.
Parameter is only stored into the caller state variable by the owner-only setter.
Parameter is only stored into the router state variable by the owner-only setter.
